steps.prompt: Think of a time something didn’t go as planned. What did it teach you?

cards.title: A true story with a point
cards.body: A narrative essay tells a true experience and shows what it meant. The introduction ends with the focus; the body paragraphs tell the events in order; the conclusion reflects.

cards.title: Events and details
cards.body: Use time words (At first, Then, Suddenly, Finally) and details of what you saw, heard and felt. Each event moves toward the lesson.

cards.title: Reflect at the end
cards.body: The conclusion looks back: “I learned…”, “Ever since…”, “Now I understand…”. The essay map marks it as your reflection.

prompts: Which detail brings your story most to life?
Does your reflection match your focus?
